audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer tracks Courage on every line without ever giving its cooldown, and never once names Decisive Strike — the ability that actually beats Galio. The content layer calls his abilities 'Q-strike' and 'Spin-to-Win' rather than their names.
audit.why: Decisive Strike is a flat 8s and its empowered hit silences: 'His next attack strikes a vital area of his foe, dealing bonus damage and silencing them.' A silence stops the Shield of Durand channel from starting, which is Galio's whole trade. Courage is 22s at rank 1 and grants 'a shield and tenacity for a brief moment followed by a lesser amount of damage reduction' — the tenacity is what shortens the taunt you do land. Judgment is 9s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Decisive Strike and Judgment named in both layers, Courage's 22s and Decisive Strike's 8s written into the cooldown block, stage lines, do's, don'ts and key interactions.

audit.whatIsWrong: diff reads EVEN at 6/10 and report[14] says 'Even matchup', but both charts give Garen five of seven stages and the headline is 45.33% over 75 games — the largest sample in this slice.
audit.why: A lane the enemy owns from level 1 through the first item, at 45.33% over 75 games, is not even.
audit.corrected: diff HARD, diffRating 7/10, and the rating and chart summaries matched to the stages. No stage was moved.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5].why calls Stormsurge/Riftmaker your spike on a stage the chart gives Garen, phases[4].why ends with the boilerplate 'Reassess his ultimate too', and phases[6].why is the same 'best teamfight button in the game' filler used everywhere.
audit.why: His spikes are Courage at 2, Demacian Justice at 6 (120s at rank 1) and his first item; yours are level 3, level 6 and two items — and the one that matters at 6 is that Garen has no dash, so he cannot follow a roam.
audit.corrected: Stage lines rebuilt on those, with the no-dash point made explicit.

audit.whatIsWrong: Neither layer tells you the one thing that denies his sustain.
audit.why: Perseverance only ticks 'if Garen has not recently been struck by damage or enemy abilities' — a Winds of War tick switches it off. That is free value from a poke you were casting anyway, and it never appears on the page.
audit.corrected: Written into the winCon, the Levels 4-5 stage, the cooldown block and whys[3].

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization says 'Oblivion Orb early — his healing fights your trade math' and leaves boots as a coin flip.
audit.why: Garen has no healing ability at all; the only health return is Perseverance's regeneration, so the line needs to say regen, not healing. Every point of his damage except Demacian Justice is physical, which settles the boot.
audit.corrected: Regen named instead of healing, Plated Steelcaps chosen outright, and the true-damage caveat on his ultimate kept where the content layer already had it right.

edits.before: By level 3 you have the W-taunt-into-E-knockup combo, but it is a coin flip here, not a win — he trades short with Spin-to-Win, cuts your magic burst with Courage, and the tenacity from W shortens the taunt you do land. Your real swing is level 6: Hero's Entrance does not win the 1v1, but it lets you flag onto mid or bot with a knockup-taunt while Garen has no dash to follow. Roam, do not duel.
